title: Cloud Infrastructure Spending Surges 55% to Hit $168B in Q3 2026

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Google Cloud reported revenue of $30.7B during the third quarter, a growth rate of 103% fueled by increased demand for AI infrastructure and core cloud solutions. This expansion helped the three largest providers in the industry capture more than 60% of total market share, with Amazon Web Services leading at 26%, followed by Microsoft Azure at 19% and Google Cloud Platform at 16%.

Overall cloud infrastructure spending rose 55% year over year in the period to reach $168B. AWS saw its fastest growth in nearly 5 years with a 39.3% increase and a current backlog of $578B, while Azure revenue grew 48% due to CPU monetization and its Foundry offerings.
